findings.affected_surface: agy effort-fold logging in all three dispatch rails
findings.claim: The plan does not define whether a fold is detected against the raw requested effort or its clamped value.
findings.evidence: The plan says to emit a note when the alias suffix and '--effort' disagree, but the default request is 'xhigh', which clamps to 'high'. For a '-high' model, raw comparison would emit a note while effective-value comparison would not. No test covers this case.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan section 1 ruling 1; dispatch-suite cases in section 2; frozen rubric R3
findings.repair: Define the fold predicate as resolved tier differing from 'agy_effort_clamp' of the requested effort, and add a default-'xhigh' plus '-high' zero-note preservation case to all three dispatch suites.

findings.claim: The proposed test does not prove that the diagnostic contains the thrown code or message.
findings.evidence: The assertion only matches '^readiness: strict bootstrap unavailable \(.+\)', so any nonempty placeholder would pass even though R6 requires the actual thrown code or message.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan section 2 status-cli.test.sh bullet and section 4 readiness-fallback-loud criterion; frozen rubric R6
findings.repair: Give the failure fixture a known error code or message and assert that exact value appears in the single readiness diagnostic line while retaining the receipt deep-equality and exit-zero checks.

findings.claim: The purported exact output-path seal is internally inconsistent and does not enumerate its test files.
findings.evidence: The plan says 'the six test files above', but seven modified test files are named: three dispatch suites, status-cli, autopilot-cli, implementation-campaign-state, and provider-readiness-consumer.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan section 2 test bullets and sealed output_paths paragraph; frozen rubric R10
findings.repair: Replace the shorthand with an explicit repo-relative list of all seven writable test paths and retain provider-readiness.test.sh only as an unchanged acceptance suite.

findings.affected_surface: CHANGELOG ownership versus sealed output boundary
findings.claim: The plan permits a CHANGELOG.md release edit outside the sealed output_paths, contradicting R10's prohibition on changes outside that seal.
findings.evidence: The sealed-path paragraph states that CHANGELOG.md is a depth-0 release action and is not sealed, while R10 requires that no file outside sealed output_paths change.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan section 2 sealed output_paths paragraph; frozen rubric R10
findings.repair: Either add CHANGELOG.md to the sealed output_paths or explicitly exclude its modification from this deliverable and perform no CHANGELOG edit until a separately authorized release operation.
